lines.text: Have you ever wondered, what actually happens inside a firecracker when it explodes?
lines.sub: Have you ever wondered… what actually happens inside a firecracker when it explodes?

lines.text: Inside a typical firecracker, a fast-burning energetic material releases heat and gases.
lines.sub: Inside a typical firecracker, a fast-burning energetic material releases heat and gases.

lines.text: As the reaction happens rapidly, pressure builds inside its casing.
lines.sub: As the reaction happens rapidly, pressure builds inside its casing.

lines.text: When the pressure rises extremely fast, the casing ruptures suddenly.
lines.sub: When the pressure rises extremely fast, the casing ruptures suddenly.

lines.text: The expanding gases create a loud bang, a pressure wave, and the explosive burst we hear and see.
lines.sub: The expanding gases create a loud bang, a pressure wave, and the explosive burst we hear and see.

lines.text: But how do some fireworks fly? Rockets move upward because gases escape downward, producing thrust.
lines.sub: But how do some fireworks fly? Rockets move upward because gases escape downward, producing thrust.

lines.text: Spinning fireworks rotate because their exhaust creates turning force.
lines.sub: Spinning fireworks rotate because their exhaust creates turning force.

lines.text: One reaction, different effects. Explosion, thrust, and rotation.
lines.sub: One reaction… different effects. Explosion, thrust, and rotation.

lines.text: Never experiment with firecrackers yourself. Enjoy fireworks safely!
